MIC_distributions

Maarten Punt

2026-04-15 15:23:01.883029

This script generates the MIC distribution plots

1 Load data

2 Set-up parameters

source(here("src", "theme.R"))
source(here("src", "MIC_plot_functions.R"))

3 Organize the MIC levels

mic_levels  <- c("0.031", "0.062", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8", "16", ">16")
mic_columns <- c("itc", "pos", "vrc", "vor", "teb", "pro", "dif", "pth")
# Function to apply this order to a column
reorder_column_fixed <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = mic_levels, ordered = TRUE)
}
# List of MIC columns in your dataframe
# Apply to all MIC columns
for (col in mic_columns) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[col]] <- reorder_column_fixed(df[[col]])
  }
}
df_sp <- df %>% filter(species %in% c('aspergillus niger','aspergillus tubingensis'))

4 Build plots

First we generate plots of the total population:

p1 <- make_mic_plot(df,"itc",clin_env_set, "Itraconazole", mic_levels, "2",show_legend=T)
p2 <- make_mic_plot(df,"pos",clin_env_set, "Posaconazole", mic_levels, "0.5",show_legend=T)
p3 <- make_mic_plot(df,"vrc",clin_env_set, "Voriconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T)

azole_plots <- (p1 + p2 + p3) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')
azole_plots

Now separate by species.

p1_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"itc",clin_env_set, "Itraconazole", mic_levels, "2",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')
p2_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pos",clin_env_set, "Posaconazole", mic_levels, "0.5",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')
p3_sep <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"vrc",clin_env_set, "Voriconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')

azole_species_plots <-(p1_sep + p2_sep + p3_sep) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')
azole_species_plots

Now we do the same for the agricultural fungicides:

p4 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pro",clin_env_set, "Prochloraz",      mic_levels, "8",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')
p5 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"pth",clin_env_set, "Prothioconazole", mic_levels, "4",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')
p6 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"dif",clin_env_set, "Difenoconazole",  mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')
p7 <- make_mic_plot(df_sp,"teb",clin_env_set, "Tebuconazole",    mic_levels, "16",show_legend=T, facet_by = 'species')

azole_agri_plots <- (p4 + p5 + p6 + p7) + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect")&
  theme(legend.position='bottom')
azole_agri_plots

5 Save the plots

dir_path = here::here("plots")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/S1_mic_agri_plots.svg"), plot = azole_agri_plots,  width = 12,  height = 12,   bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/S1_mic_species_plots.svg"), plot = azole_species_plots,  width = 12,  height = 12,   bg = "white")
ggsave(filename = glue::glue("{dir_path}/Fig_1_mic_azoles.svg"), plot = azole_plots, width = 12, height = 10,   bg = "white")
